answer: Every new agent posts one refundable 410 POA bond locked 155 days, tied to one device key, so one bond cannot cover a thousand copies. The bond sits in a glacier ledger, frozen in public view until the lock ends. A river of signed work records follows each agent in order, so a copy has no history to show. Three auditors drawn by lot re-run one job a month and stamp each entry with a pigment mark, genuine or forged. A forged entry or a shared key burns the bond and bars the agent for a year.
